items.html: And behold, at forty days, when the form of the offspring is completed, it has the phase of the filling of MA and SAG. Also, if you count the sparks themselves — 19, 37 — it will be 56, and they are the gematria of El HaVaYaH 75. For it has already been explained by us that the name HaVaYaH is in ZA, and it has also been explained by us that the phase of the two names El HaVaYaH is in the world of Yetzira, for now it is completed and finished, to be called by these two names.
